params.body:
The Observatory's bar and index, after a round of looking.

- **Data and System sat 1px lower than the links.** The dropdown triggers had no bottom edge while the links keep a 2px transparent one for their underline. Same box now; measured: every item in the row 34px tall, text at the same top.
- **Icons beside the words**: a line icon (16px, the text colour) next to each item in the bar and in both menus. Next to the words, never instead of them.
- **People is now Accounts**: the page manages the accounts on gentells.com and access to the Observatory.
- **Index: opened detail reads as detail.** Open, the machine's detail and the corpus sit in a tinted panel under the sentence that opened them, and the sentence says "Hide the detail". Before, the opened content looked like the next section.
- Numbers on the index get thousands separators (3,133 classified; 10,367 of 10,367 patterns), and a worker row no longer breaks "5 done" over two lines.

Build ok, lint ratchet at its ceiling, e2e pass.
params.title: Observatory: bar, icons, Accounts, folded detail
